name: ownership_dilution_from_new_issue
question_template: Apply only this fictional scenario-local securities calculation. An investor holds {SHARES_HELD} shares of an issuer with {SHARES_OUTSTANDING} shares outstanding. The issuer then issues {NEW_SHARES} new shares, all to other parties; the investor buys none. Ownership percent is 100 times shares held divided by total shares outstanding. Compute the signed change in the investor's ownership in percentage points, post-issue minus pre-issue. Use exact arithmetic. Report pre-issue and post-issue ownership percent.

slots.description: Exact ownership percent before the new issue.
Ownership percent after the new issue.

program:
def solve():
    held = P["SHARES_HELD"]
    outstanding = P["SHARES_OUTSTANDING"]
    new = P["NEW_SHARES"]
    if held >= outstanding:
        raise ValueError("shares held must be less than shares outstanding")
    pre = Fraction(100 * held, outstanding)
    post = Fraction(100 * held, outstanding + new)
    change = post - pre
    return {
        "final": change,
        "pre_issue_ownership_percent": pre,
        "post_issue_ownership_percent": post
    }
